entities.summary: The Al-Sarraji Mosque is a former Sunni mosque, that was located in the Abi al-Khasib district in Basra, in the Basra Governorate of Iraq. The Al-Sarraji Mosque is characterized by its ancient heritage and archaeological architecture and is distinguished by its luxurious archaeological minaret built of ancient bricks. The mosque is registered with on the Iraqi list of heritage places.
